source: SPEC.md §9.5 (Scribe deliverables): era goal names + descriptions (11), first-run primer copy, tooltip strings, choice-delta flavor lines.

era_goals.name: Master Fire
era_goals.description: Keep a stolen flame alive long enough that warmth stops being a rumor and starts being a schedule.

era_goals.name: Break the Ground
era_goals.description: Bend a grass into a crop, store the surplus, and accept whatever hierarchy the full granary installs in exchange.

era_goals.name: Mint an Empire
era_goals.description: Turn value into stamped metal and roads into law, before overextension presents you the cancellation fee.

era_goals.name: Keep the Flame
era_goals.description: Copy what you know by candlelight through the bottleneck; forgetting is the era, transcription is the resistance.

era_goals.name: Set Type
era_goals.description: Buy the press and put ideas on paper fast enough that reformation, plague, and science all arrive on your shift.

era_goals.name: Electrify
era_goals.description: Convert coal into motion at scale and mind the smog, because this is where the pollution counter starts keeping score.

era_goals.name: Win the Century
era_goals.description: Run the lines, finance the wars, and make consumption the operating system before the market asks whether you're selling.

era_goals.name: Hold the Clock
era_goals.description: Split the atom and survive your own deterrent: keep minutes-to-midnight counting up instead of out.

era_goals.name: Scale the Curve
era_goals.description: Ride compute doubling on schedule, hire your first agent staff, and outlive the crash that deletes offices but spares protocols.

era_goals.name: Own the Feed
era_goals.description: Extract attention at twenty-four hours a day without letting the feed's corruption tax reprice everything else you own.

era_goals.name: Sign Yourself
era_goals.description: Upload, fork, and settle who owns your life when every heir is you — before the Benthics itemize the answer.

first_run_primer: Resources tick every second. They have no nights off and no memory of your intentions.
Events need choices. There is no option called 'wait and see' — waiting is the option; someone else picks 'see'.
Fill the bar to advance the era. It advances regardless. The only question is what you'll be when it does.

tooltips.sustenance: Whatever this era counts as food: grain, coin, coal, compute. The appetite outlives every menu.
tooltips.knowledge: What you know, minus what got burned, forgotten, or left in a format nobody can open.
tooltips.population: The people carrying the lineage forward. Later, the copies. Complaints included at no extra charge.
tooltips.infrastructure: Roads, grids, servers — arguments won against entropy. Renew annually or lose the verdict.
tooltips.legitimacy: How much everyone else agrees it's you in charge. Cheaper than legions, harder to store.
tooltips.entropy: Pollution, risk, debt. Never goes down easily. At 100, the lineage ends.

delta_flavor.gain: +{n} {res}. Somewhere an ancestor nods. They want something.
delta_flavor.loss: −{n} {res}. Paid now or later; later has worse rates.
delta_flavor.badge: Badge earned: {badge}. Permanent, non-negotiable, visible forever — like the choice that got it.
